title: NASA Sets Coverage for Northrop Grumman CRS-25 Launch, Prelaunch
description: NASA, Northrop Grumman, and SpaceX are targeting no earlier than 10:47 a.m. EST, Sunday, Nov. 29, for the next launch delivering science investigations, supplies, and equipment to the International Space Station.
